Letters

Join us in supporting Adam Hundt

Erin and Andrew Schultz · October 7, 2026 · 1 min read

Editor,

As Piedmont residents since 2012 and parents of two Piedmont Middle School students, we offer our enthusiastic support for Adam Hundt’s candidacy for Piedmont City Council.

In a close-knit city like Piedmont, effective leadership requires a deep understanding of our community’s values and priorities, along with a rigorous, forward-looking approach to our unique challenges. Adam embodies these qualities. He has a natural curiosity and is already hard at work listening to and learning from other residents and city leaders. His educational background in business, engineering, and public policy gives him sharp problem-solving skills and a collaborative style, while his professional experience in operations and supply chain management provides the analytical discipline needed to tackle Piedmont’s long-term infrastructure challenges.

As a father of two young children, Adam has his finger on the pulse of the issues facing local families and demonstrates a genuine drive to ensure Piedmont remains a welcoming place for residents of all ages. His platform strikes the right balance for our city’s future, placing emphasis on energy-efficient home upgrades, improved sustainability, and mitigating community risks from wildfires and other natural threats.

Adam will bring a fresh perspective, analytical approach, and creative problem-solving to Piedmont’s city governance. We’re excited to support his candidacy and encourage you to join us in voting for Adam Hundt for City Council.

Sincerely, Erin and Andrew Schultz
